newsitem.title: CANADA: Cableshare okays Source Media bid.
newsitem.headline: Cableshare okays Source Media bid.

text.p: Cableshare Inc said its shareholders approved a takeover bid from Dallas-based Source Media Inc.
The company said Source Media will acquire all of the issued and outstanding class A subordinate voting shares and class B multiple voting shares for C$2.25 of Source Media common stock.
The deal is expected to be closed by February 15, 1997, subject to regulatory approval.

Under the terms of the plan Cableshare shareholders will receive that number of Source Media shares equal to the number of class A shares and class B shares held by them divided by 5.0156, being the exchange ratio calculated in accordance with the plan of arrangement. The exchange ratio was determined by reference to the weighted average trading price of Source Media common stock on the Nasdaq market over the 20 trading days ending on December 16, 1996.
The total value of the share consideration offered to Cableshare holders about C$18.3 million.
